Mission Local reported that MEDA bought a 16-unit building at 17th and Mission streets for $7.75 million. Most of its 11 residential and five commercial spaces were occupied by longtime, low-income tenants. The purchase was made through the city’s Small Sites Program, with a bridge loan from the San Francisco Housing Accelerator program while MEDA awaited public funds. The story described the program as aiming to protect longtime residents and neighborhood-serving areas.
